title: 第3256章 大道混元经的力量变化第3255章 适才相戏耳
lines: 碎雪草的气息！
听到杀生神女所言，萧诺当即把刚才极雷宗一行人上交的储物袋全部都打开，然后一股脑的将里边的材料都倒了出来。
各种各样的材料顿时悬浮在萧诺的面前。
很快，萧诺的注意力就锁定在了一株雪白色小草上面。
这株小草也就十几公分的高度。
叶子纤细，柔弱！
在叶子上面有着独特的白色符文。
虽然只是一株小草，但它散发出来的气息却不弱。
萧诺将其抓在手中，一股寒霜释放出来，瞬间于萧诺的掌心表面凝结出了一层薄霜。
杀生神女说道：“不错，的确是碎雪草！”
塔灵也说道：“看来运气还可以啊！这几个极雷宗的弟子身上还真捡到宝了。”
萧诺询问道：“碎雪草有什么用处？”
杀生神女开口道：“碎雪草对你没什么用处……”
萧诺一愣。
对自己没有用处？
那杀生神女说来干嘛？
但萧诺知道杀生神女不会无缘无故的拿自己开玩笑，所以他没有打断对方，而是让杀生神女继续讲解。
“你所需要的东西，名为‘霜灵涎’，一般情况下，碎雪草的附近，有一定的概率会出现‘霜灵涎’。”
“霜灵涎？”萧诺眼中的疑惑更甚：“那霜灵涎的用处又是什么？”
青眸丹神开口说道：“霜灵涎是冰属性的天材地宝，貌似对萧诺的《鸿蒙霸体诀》修炼没多大用处吧？”
倾城酒仙也说道：“对啊！我也纳闷呢！要‘霜灵涎’这玩意有什么用？”
萧诺也感到好奇。
塔灵笑道：“霜灵涎修炼的应该不是《鸿蒙霸体诀》，而是那《大道混元经》。”
萧诺心头一动。
在这之前，萧诺已经知道了《混元天书》的另一个名字，《大道混元经》，而在堕灵门的时候，萧诺凭借一根“混沌树”的树枝，成功的把《大道混元经》修炼到了第四阶段。
混元大阵的力量也迎来了一个本质的变化。
之前只能召唤出一朵大道之花，现在可以一次性召唤出十朵。
而且，每一朵大道之花的力量都相当强大。
杀生神女给予肯定：“不错，霜灵涎的用途，是用在《大道混元经》上面的……”
顿了顿，
杀生神女继续讲解：“有了‘霜灵涎’，你就可以把‘极霜大阵’融入‘混元大阵’中，将两种阵法结合在一起。”
闻言，萧诺有些诧异，他疑惑的问道：“极霜大阵和混元大阵融合？可是‘极霜大阵’是用阵盘控制的啊，这要如何把它们进行融合？”
极霜大阵和混元大阵虽然都是阵法。
但两者的催动方法并不一样。
极霜大阵是用阵盘开启的，那件阵盘相当于一件法宝。
混元大阵则是萧诺“以身为阵”所掌控的。
当初萧诺将“混元大阵”刻在了自己的身上，只需要一个念头，萧诺就能催动阵法杀敌。
杀生神女说道：“很简单，到时候直接把‘极霜大阵’也刻在你的身上，如此一来，两座阵法便可进行融合，混元大阵的威力便能更上一层楼！”
此言一出，不光萧诺惊到了，鸿蒙金塔中的其他诸位女帝妖后也是倍感诧异。
倾城酒仙开口道：“你确定这样可以吗？可别把我们家萧诺给玩坏了！”
塔灵笑道：“放心，玩不坏的，你们别小看《大道混元经》了，它比《鸿蒙霸体诀》差不了多少的。”
杀生神女也跟着道：“萧诺已经把《混元天书》修炼到了第四阶段，这第四阶段不仅仅只是让‘大道之花’的数量增加那么简单，这个阶段最大的特点，就是放大了‘以身为阵’的权限范围，很多阵法都可以刻在萧诺身上……”
听完杀生神女的讲解，萧诺心中无比惊叹。
content_en:
The smell of crushed snow grass!
After hearing what the Killing Goddess said, Xiao Nuo immediately opened all the storage bags that the Ji Lei Sect and his party had just handed over, and then poured out all the materials inside.
Various materials were suddenly suspended in front of Xiao Nuo.
Soon, Xiao Nuo's attention was focused on a snow-white grass.
This grass is only a dozen centimeters tall.
The leaves are slender and delicate!
There are unique white runes on the leaves.
Although it is just a small grass, the aura it exudes is not weak.
Xiao Nuo grabbed it in his hand, and a burst of frost was released, instantly forming a thin layer of frost on the surface of Xiao Nuo's palm.
The Killing Goddess said: "Yes, it is indeed broken snow grass!"
Ta Ling also said: "It seems that your luck is not bad! These Ji Lei Sect disciples really found treasures on their bodies."
Xiao Nuo asked: "What is the use of broken snow grass?"
The Killing Goddess said: "Snowflake grass is of no use to you..."
Xiao Nuo was stunned.
No use to you?
So what is the goddess of death doing here?
But Xiao Nuo knew that the Goddess of Death would not make fun of him for no reason, so he did not interrupt the other party, but let the Goddess of Death continue to explain.
"The thing you need is called 'Frost Spirit Saliva'. Under normal circumstances, there is a certain probability that 'Frost Spirit Saliva' will appear near the broken snow grass."
"Shuang Ling saliva?" Xiao Nuo's eyes were even more confused: "Then what is the use of Shuang Ling saliva?"
The Green-Eyed Alchemy God said: "Frost Spirit Saliva is an ice-attributed treasure of heaven and earth. It doesn't seem to be of much use to Xiao Nuo's practice of "Hongmeng Hegemon Body Technique", right?"
Qingcheng Jiuxian also said: "Yes! I'm wondering too! What's the use of 'Frost Spirit Saliva'?"
Xiao Nuo was also curious.
Ta Ling smiled and said: "Shuang Lingxu should not be practicing the "Hongmeng Hegemon Body Technique", but the "Dao Hunyuan Jing"."
Xiao Nuo's heart moved.
Before that, Xiao Nuo had already known the other name of "Hunyuan Heavenly Book", "Dao Hunyuan Jing", and when he was at Fallen Spirit Sect, Xiao Nuo relied on a branch of the "Chaos Tree" to successfully practice "Dao Hunyuan Jing" to the fourth stage.
The power of the Hunyuan Formation also ushered in an essential change.
Previously, only one Avenue Flower could be summoned, but now ten can be summoned at once.
Moreover, the power of each avenue flower is quite powerful.
The Killing Goddess affirmed: "Yes, the purpose of Shuang Ling's saliva is in the "Dao Hunyuan Jing"..."
After a pause,
The Killing Goddess continued to explain: "With the 'Frost Spirit Saliva', you can integrate the 'Extreme Frost Formation' into the 'Hunyuan Formation' and combine the two formations together."
Hearing this, Xiao Nuo was a little surprised. He asked doubtfully: "The fusion of the Extreme Frost Formation and the Hunyuan Formation? But the 'Extreme Frost Formation' is controlled by an array disk. How to fuse them?"
Although the Extreme Frost Formation and the Hunyuan Formation are both formations.
But the stimulation methods of the two are different.
The Extreme Frost Formation is opened with a formation disk, which is equivalent to a magic weapon.
The Hunyuan Formation is controlled by Xiao Nuo's "body formation".
When Xiao Nuo carved the "Hunyuan Formation" on his body, with just a thought, Xiao Nuo could activate the formation to kill the enemy.
The Killing Goddess said: "It's very simple. When the time comes, the 'Extreme Frost Formation' will be engraved on your body. In this way, the two formations can be fused, and the power of the Hunyuan Formation will be even greater!"
As soon as these words came out, not only Xiao Nuo was shocked, but the other empresses and demon empresses in Hongmeng Golden Pagoda were also surprised.
Qingcheng Jiuxian said: "Are you sure this is okay? Don't spoil our Xiao Nuo!"
Ta Ling smiled and said: "Don't worry, you can't play badly. Don't underestimate the "Dao Hunyuan Jing", it is not much worse than the "Hongmeng Ba Ti Jue"."
The Killing Goddess also followed: "Xiao Nuo has cultivated the "Hunyuan Heavenly Book" to the fourth stage. This fourth stage is not just about increasing the number of 'Flowers of the Avenue'. The biggest feature of this stage is that it enlarges the scope of authority of the 'Body Array'. Many formations can be engraved on Xiao Nuo..."
After listening to the explanation of the Killing Goddess, Xiao Nuo was extremely amazed.
title_en: Chapter 3256: Changes in the power of the Great Dao Hunyuan Sutra Chapter 3255: Just now, I was joking
